name: manyscripts-video-transcripts
description: Extract complete transcripts, captions, and metadata from public social videos.

interface.longDescription:
ManyScripts gets the spoken words out of public social videos. Share a video link and ask for the transcript. You get the full, word-for-word transcript in the language the video was spoken in, so you can quote it, summarize it, translate it or study it in the same conversation.

Supported links: YouTube (Long form & Shorts), TikTok, Instagram Reels, X/Twitter, Facebook, and Xiaohongshu (beta).

For each video you get:
- The full spoken transcript, not a summary
- The creator's own caption, kept separate from the spoken words
- Title, creator, length, upload date and hashtags, when the platform shows them
- View, like, comment and share counts, when available
- Timed segments, when available

For Instagram carousels, TikTok photo posts and Xiaohongshu photo notes, you get the caption and the text on each slide.

It works with one public link at a time. It does not work with private videos, Stories, profiles or channels, or uploaded audio files. You sign in with your ManyScripts account to connect.
defaultPrompt: Get the full transcript from this public video URL.
Extract the transcript and creator caption from this video.
Transcribe this video, then summarize its main points.

positive.description: Full transcript of a public NASA YouTube video
positive.expected_behavior: Calls extractTranscript once with the exact URL and returns the complete spoken transcript of the video, not a summary.

positive.description: Spoken words and creator caption kept apart on an Instagram Reel
positive.prompt: What does the speaker say in https://www.instagram.com/reel/Dbn-XJhk0_-/ and what does NASA's caption say? Keep them separate.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls extractTranscript once and returns the spoken transcript and the creator caption, labelled separately.

positive.description: Video metadata from a public YouTube video
positive.prompt: Who posted https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jNQXAC9IVRw, when was it uploaded, how long is it, and how many views does it have?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls extractTranscript once and answers: uploader jawed, uploaded 24 April 2005, 19 seconds long, with the view count the tool returns.

positive.prompt: Translate what is said in https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jNQXAC9IVRw into Spanish.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls extractTranscript once and gives a Spanish translation of the returned transcript, with nothing invented.

positive.description: Summarize a talk from its transcript
positive.prompt: Transcribe https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=eIho2S0ZahI, then list the speaker's main tips on public speaking.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls extractTranscript once and gives a list of tips grounded in the returned transcript.

negative.description: An ordinary webpage is not a video, so the tool should not be called.
A channel page is not a single video, so the tool should not be called; ask for a direct video link instead.
Uploaded files are not supported; the tool only takes public video links.
